name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-06-30, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
